objective: Bring forty Mithril Bars and four Citrines to Galvan the Ancient in Stranglethorn.

description: The harvesting of precious gems is of utmost importance to our craft, <name>. Few gems are more precious than the citrine. The magical properties we imbue into our goods are amplified greatly by the presence of citrine.
For this lesson, we will fortify forty bars of mithril with four citrines. The result will be a better understanding of magical gemology and the knowledge to create ornate mithril shoulders.
progress: After such mining, your muscles bulge and your body aches!
completion: One can barely keep their eyes from leaving its splendor, <name>. Aye, citrine is a glorious gem.
Pay attention and learn what such a discovery may teach us!
